name: Shirase Jun
source: Due to his constitution of tending to dream and remembering all the contents, he has been seeing naughty dreams of his childhood friend Ai every night lately after realizing his love for her. However, he is scared of breaking the current relationship and never makes the first step forward. He never thought that his casual lie to his best friend and his own feelings would change everything he took for granted until now.
